description: Get the full Toolocate listing of one AI tool: description, features, who it is for, FAQs, pricing plans, platforms, agent access, the official url and pageUrl, the Toolocate page to cite. checkedAt is when we last verified the official site.

locale.description: Language of the text fields and of pageUrl (default en). A tool not yet written in that language comes back in English; its locale field says which language you got.

slug.description: The tool's slug, from search_tools or from a Toolocate URL (toolocate.com/tools/<slug>/).

name: get_tool
title: Get an AI tool
